name: random simulation
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 按随机性规则生成样本并模拟系统行为的过程。

complete_examples.text: By effectively combing the vehicle-track dynamics method and random simulation methods, the wheel and rail contact stresses in amplitude and distribution range can be efficiently quantified from a statistical view.

Finally, the statistical mean contact stress and its standard deviation distribution are compared by using the proposed random simulation method and the realistically measured irregularities loading method.
